_comment: ngsolve nonlinear_elasticity#6 (dampfactor < 1 far from equilibrium). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.3 order 2, full 0.8 top displacement in one step: dampfactor=1.0 aborts with 'UmfpackInverse: Numeric factorization failed' and raising maxit 60 -> 300 does not help, while dampfactor 0.5 and 0.25 both return status 0 and hit the prescribed 0.8 exactly. Two warm-started 0.4 increments undamped also converge. Caveat: on this configuration damping did NOT cost extra iterations (counts printed, not pinned).
